name: secret-guard
description: Replaces the value of every secret with <hidden:NAME> in every tool result, MCP and subagent calls included, and puts the real value back when the agent writes the placeholder into a .env file. Refuses nothing

secretsFile.title: Secrets file
secretsFile.description: KEY=value file whose every value is a secret. A leading ~ is the home folder

envRoot.title: .env root
envRoot.description: Folder searched for .env files, 5 levels deep. A leading ~ is the home folder

minLength.title: Minimum length
minLength.description: Values shorter than this are left alone, except known token formats
